name: SafeWatch-Bench-200K
description: SafeWatch-Bench-200K is a large-scale dataset for evaluating model safety and content moderation capabilities, containing ~200K examples designed to test detection of harmful, unsafe, or policy-violating text. It measures classification performance on safety-related categories and supports benchmarking of moderation and alignment approaches.
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face; appears to be a recent community dataset with limited established adoption so far.
